SEARCH
Package neqsim.process.processmodel.dexpi

Class Dexpi20ProcessModelPackageDocumentImpact

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.processmodel.dexpi.Dexpi20ProcessModelPackageDocumentImpact
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class Dexpi20ProcessModelPackageDocumentImpact extends Object implements Serializable
Projects assessed DEXPI package changes onto controlled diagram-document views and registers.

The projection consumes independently assessed package evidence and immutable diagram document sets. It never reconstructs or executes a ProcessModel. Results identify review scope; they are not an MOC decision, drawing approval, native whole-plant DEXPI exchange, or fitness-for-construction statement.
